'''Silence''' was a prospecting town that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. The settlement had a close-knit community, but was also home to a lot of criminals and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. It was destroyed and rebuilt at least three times throughout its history, and the ruins of the old buildings lay beneath newer structures.
